verdict.rationale: Poke documents a browsable directory at poke.com/recipes that lists first-party and approved third-party recipes, including prebuilt connectors such as Linear and Webflow. Users can connect these integrations to the assistant and disconnect them later. Third parties can publish recipes to the directory, and services not listed there can be added directly as MCP servers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the directory browsing and add flow.
